description: This file is part of the Ginkgo testing framework, specifically for generating test command code. It defines functions to build a 'generate' command, handle test file creation, and manage template rendering for test files.

methods.name: BuildGenerateCommand
methods.description: Constructs and returns the 'generate' command with flags and execution logic.

methods.name: generateTestFiles
methods.description: Generates test files for each specified subject or a default if none specified.

methods.name: generateTestFileForSubject
methods.description: Creates a test file for a given subject, handling templates and file existence checks.

methods.name: formatSubject
methods.description: Sanitizes and formats a string to be a valid test subject name.

methods.name: moduleName
methods.description: Extracts the module name from a go.mod file in the specified directory.

methods.name: findModuleRoot
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the module by locating go.mod.

methods.name: getPackageImportPath
methods.description: Determines the import path of the current package based on go.mod or GOPATH.
